content.user_title: Scan Frontend Code for XSS Risks
content.value_statement: Frontend code can expose users to XSS through unsafe DOM, URLs, and raw HTML rendering. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through targeted XSS review.
actual_capabilities: Identifies unsafe DOM APIs such as innerHTML, outerHTML, document.write, and insertAdjacentHTML.
Checks React patterns including dangerouslySetInnerHTML and missing HTML sanitization.
Reviews Vue v-html usage and recommends safer text rendering patterns.
Detects URL assignment risks involving location, href values, and unsafe protocols.
Suggests practical fixes using textContent, DOMPurify, URL validation, and framework protections.
Produces grouped vulnerability reports with severity, affected files, and remediation guidance.
limitations: It depends on the code and context provided by the user.
It may miss runtime data flows that are not visible in static code.
Tool commands such as Semgrep require local installation and permission.
Results should be verified with tests and security review before release.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Check changed React, Vue, Angular, or JavaScript files for common XSS patterns before merging.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Security Audit
use_cases.description: Create an initial XSS finding list with severity, affected locations, and remediation notes.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Standards
use_cases.description: Turn recurring XSS risks into secure coding guidance for frontend teams.

prompt_templates.title: Basic XSS Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this frontend code for XSS risks. Focus on unsafe HTML rendering, URL assignment, and user-controlled input.

prompt_templates.title: Framework Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for a framework project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React, Vue, or Angular component for framework-specific XSS risks. Include safer alternatives for each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Repository Sweep
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the provided frontend files for XSS patterns. Group findings by severity and include file locations and fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning after findings are known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a remediation plan for these XSS findings. Prioritize fixes, explain residual risk, and suggest validation tests.

output_examples.input: A React component renders user-provided HTML in a preview area.
output_examples.output: High risk: raw HTML rendering needs sanitization before display. Use DOMPurify or render plain text when rich HTML is not required.

output_examples.input: A Vue template uses v-html for content from an API response.
output_examples.output: High risk: v-html renders raw HTML. Prefer v-text, or sanitize trusted rich content before it reaches the template.

output_examples.input: A handler assigns a query parameter to window.location.href.
output_examples.output: High risk: user-controlled navigation can enable unsafe protocols. Validate URLs and allow only http or https destinations.

best_practices: Provide the relevant component code and note which values come from users or external APIs.
Ask for severity, exploit impact, and a concrete fix for each finding.
Validate recommended fixes with tests, lint rules, and manual review.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every use of innerHTML as safe without checking sanitization and data origin.
Do not rely on framework defaults after bypassing built-in escaping features.
Do not accept URL values without protocol validation and destination checks.

faq.question: Does this skill execute a scanner automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and optional command examples that require user permission and local setup.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers React, Vue, Angular, and vanilla JavaScript patterns described in the skill instructions.

faq.question: Can it replace a penetration test?
faq.answer: No. It supports static review but does not replace runtime testing or expert validation.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide components, templates, handlers, routing code, and notes about user-controlled data sources.

faq.question: Does it recommend fixes?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests safer APIs, DOMPurify sanitization, URL validation, and framework-specific protections.

faq.question: Can it help write a report?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize findings by severity and include impact, location, and remediation guidance.
